description: Defines the TaxComponentData class, a data container for tax component details in the Fineract project, including fields for account types, percentages, date ranges, and history data.

classes.name: TaxComponentData
classes.description: A final class representing tax component data with multiple constructors and static factory methods, including logic for applicable percentage calculation based on date and history.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new TaxComponentData instance with provided details, initializing options to null.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a minimal TaxComponentData instance with only id and name, other fields set to null.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template TaxComponentData with provided account options, other fields null.

methods.name: createTaxComponent
methods.description: Creates a TaxComponentData instance with specified id, percentage, debit and credit accounts.

methods.name: getApplicablePercentage
methods.description: Calculates the applicable percentage based on the date and tax component history.

methods.name: occursOnDayFrom
methods.description: Checks if a given date occurs after the start date.
